title: Renew a paintball marker permit
summary: This page explains how to renew your paintball marker permit online when your current permit is nearing expiry.
intro:
When your current paintball marker permit is nearing expiry, you’ll receive an email prompting you to renew online.

Note: You can only access the online renewal application through your renewal email.

You must submit your renewal application before your permit expires.

You can renew for 1, 3 or 5 years.
who_can_apply: You must pass a fit and proper person assessment.
what_you_need: One proof of identity document (such as a driver licence or Australian passport)

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to renew the paintball marker permit.

more_info.text: The same fee applies for a 1, 3 or 5-year permit.
If your licence expired within 3 months of the expiry date, you can restore your licence.
If your licence expired more than 3 months after the expiry date you'll need to apply for a new licence and complete the paintball marker safety training course.
You can contact Fair Trading to find out your expiry date.

faqs.q: How do I start the renewal process?
faqs.a: You will receive an email prompting you to renew online when your current permit is nearing expiry. You must use this renewal email to access the application.

faqs.q: How long can I renew my permit for?
faqs.a: You can renew your permit for 1, 3, or 5 years.

faqs.q: What do I need to renew my permit?
faqs.a: You need your renewal notice email, a MyServiceNSW Account, your contact details, one proof of identity (like a driver licence or Australian passport), and your fee payment.
